name: Westrock Coffee - North Little Rock AR Roasting & Manufacturing

fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck entrance. The facility sits inside the multi-tenant Collins Industrial Place industrial park; satellite and 2024 Street View show open, unmarked driveways and shared paved aprons connecting buildings — no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint at the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere on the site or at the park access.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors are on the building's southwest arm; ~6-8 bays estimated with 3-4 trailers backed in (wc-04-sat-n imagery). Resolution and roof glare limit an exact count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A few trailers stand near the SW dock arm; no large marked drop-stall lot belonging to Westrock. The big dirt lot full of trucks/RVs/salvage east of the building is a SEPARATE adjacent salvage/towing operation, not Westrock's yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town light-industrial subdivision in North Little Rock — judged Rural per the small-town-industrial rubric tiebreak.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Approach from the park drive to the dock arm is short (1-2 trucks).
